Applied to both boxes 2026-08-30, after its own falsification test resolved IN FAVOUR. The proposal said: if broker time minus time.time() is zero, deal.time is true UTC and the fix is aimed at the wrong line. Running that needs a second MT5 client, which can drop the live bridge off IPC with positions open, so the same premise was tested READ-ONLY from bars the bridge already pushes: newest H1 bar decoded to 22:00 UTC while real UTC was 19:33. An H1 bar cannot open 2.44h in the future, so the epochs carry BROKER wall clock. Broker UTC+3 rendered into BST UTC+1 gives +4h, matching the 3h59m32s contradiction exactly. Premise CONFIRMED. Both parts applied together as the proposal requires: summarize_closed_position stamps closeTime at observation in explicit UTC and carries the raw figure as closeTimeBroker; breaker_day() moved to UTC so record_closed_outcome's close_time[:10] == breaker_day() stays consistent - proved by construction that a 23:30Z close would be misfiled if only one moved. Both tuple unpack sites widened to 4 and both payloads carry the new field; server/index.js destructure extended to accept and store it, or the bridge would have been a writer with no reader. NOT YET LIVE: the running bridge holds the old code and will pick this up at its next restart; safe_bridge_restart refuses with 3 positions open and was not overridden.
